policy: These rows pin the exact current physical siblings of logical PS4 package family 0250. They establish byte identity and package-family membership only; semantic ownership remains source-derived from D1 FileHash/resource graphs. All six siblings must be available to resolve payloads because an entry-table occurrence does not guarantee that the resident payload is stored in the same physical sibling.
